question_text: Two ML translation models use training data of different quality. Outline how noisy or in correctly paired training sentences can reduce model performance.
adaptation_rationale: Preserves training-data quality reasoning while avoiding unsupported claims about particular languages or mandatory NLP internals.
solution: Incorrect pairs provide misleading input-output relationships during training.; The learned model can therefore produce less accurate translations; cleaning those pairs improves the training evidence.
